statistics.indicator: Total water withdrawal for irrigation, Republic of Uzbekistan (national total only in the published table)

provenance.role: Annual national irrigation withdrawal as published (SIAT data file via api.siat.stat.uz, indicator 3.01.02.0002).

notes: National aggregate; no regional breakdown is published in this indicator table, so no regional values are stored.

statistics.indicator: Total dam capacity, Uzbekistan (AQUASTAT survey, as reported in Irrigation in Central Asia in Figures)

provenance.role: AQUASTAT-reported national dam capacity aggregate (22.2 km3; the same survey reports at least 50 reservoirs totalling over 22 km3).

notes: National design-capacity aggregate; it exceeds the sum of the 24 CAWater records in this dataset because CAWater does not list every Uzbek reservoir. Not measured storage.
